manifest.name: enriched-field
manifest.description: One contact attribute filled from a free enrichment source (Google Contacts, an email signature), held beside the contact record rather than inside it. The contact record is never written by enrichment, so a manually entered value always wins by construction. Every row carries its source and observation date; an opt-out purges the active rows of its subject.

migrations.name: create_enriched_fields
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS enriched_fields (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  subject_resource TEXT,
  subject_id TEXT,
  subject_owner TEXT CHECK(subject_owner IN ('host', 'package')),
  subject_owner_package TEXT,
  subject_label TEXT,
  field TEXT,
  value TEXT,
  source TEXT,
  source_detail TEXT,
  observed_at TEXT,
  observed_by_run_id TEXT,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('active', 'purged')),
  purged_at TEXT,
  purge_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS enriched_fields_subject_resource ON enriched_fields(subject_resource);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS enriched_fields_subject_id ON enriched_fields(subject_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS enriched_fields_field ON enriched_fields(field);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS enriched_fields_source ON enriched_fields(source);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS enriched_fields_status ON enriched_fields(status);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_enriched_fields
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "subject_resource" TEXT,
  "subject_id" TEXT,
  "subject_owner" TEXT CHECK("subject_owner" IN ('host', 'package')),

  "subject_label" TEXT,
  "field" TEXT,
  "value" TEXT,
  "source" TEXT,
  "source_detail" TEXT,
  "observed_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "observed_by_run_id" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'purged')),
  "purged_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "purge_reason" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "enriched_fields_subject_resource"

CREATE INDEX "enriched_fields_subject_id"
  ON "accordo"."enriched_fields"("subject_id");

CREATE INDEX "enriched_fields_field"

CREATE INDEX "enriched_fields_source"

CREATE INDEX "enriched_fields_status"
  ON "accordo"."enriched_fields"("status");
